t: Three sentences with the same opening
a: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ جَائِزَتَهُ
p: Man kāna yuʾminu bi-Llāhi wa-l-yawmi-l-ākhiri fa-l-yukrim jārah, wa man kāna yuʾminu bi-Llāhi wa-l-yawmi-l-ākhiri fa-l-yukrim ḍayfahu jāʾizatah
m: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his guest with his due.
